concerns.text: T022 mandates shuffling labels across the 'full dataset' to generate a null distribution. This violates the Plan (Phase 2) and Constitution Principle VII which explicitly require permutation testing on the 'held-out test set' to validate predictive validity without data leakage. Shuffling the full dataset invalidates the train/test split logic defined in T017 and the spec's requirement for out-of-sample validation.

FR-008 requires re-running the 'full analysis pipeline' (including correlations and sensitivity checks) with alternative parameters. T025a-c only re-run preprocessing, feature extraction, and modeling. The tasks omit the re-execution of correlation tests (FR-006) and sensitivity analysis (FR-009) on the robustness data, failing to satisfy the 'full pipeline' acceptance criteria.

T012a implements Welch's PSD with '4-second windows' but the Plan (Phase 1) and Constitution Principle VI explicitly mandate '2-s windows'. While the Spec (FR-003) mentions 4s, the Plan and Constitution (which govern implementation details) specify 2s. The task silently relaxes the Plan/Constitution constraint without a documented amendment, creating a drift between the implementation plan and the task.

The Plan (Phase 1) explicitly mandates applying a 'Centered Log-Ratio (CLR) transformation' to handle compositional data constraints. T012c only calculates 'relative power' and the General Notes state 'CLR Transformation Removed'. This is a silent relaxation of a specific methodological requirement in the Plan, violating the constraint that tasks must not silently relax what the plan demands.
